response.reason: The trusted checker report (authenticated HMAC-SHA256) validates this separating set certificate. The report confirms: (1) principal u_fca5 is in the set (principal_in_set: true), (2) resource x_beec is outside the set (resource_outside_set: true), (3) zero leaking edges exist from set members to non-members (leaking_edge_count: 0, leaking_edges: []), and (4) the verdict is VALID. These satisfy all requirements of the separating set protocol, proving u_fca5 cannot access x_beec under this RBAC policy.

trusted_report.scope: VALID means the stated principal cannot access the stated resource under this policy. It certifies only the stated principal and resource.
